findings.evidence: Topology.lean already defines isClopen_setOf_eval and the product topology; Coding.lean:57–100 uses only that earlier API.
findings.fix: Move cylinder, mem_cylinder, mem_cylinder_eval, isClopen_cylinder, measurableSet_cylinder and isTopologicalBasis_cylinder to Topology.lean beside the existing cylinder result.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:88 defines atom_inj, the only project lemma used by Atom.infinite_of_relations; Basic.lean:184 contains atom countability. Topology.lean:109 defines mk_le_continuum, and mk_eq_continuum uses no query-code declarations.
findings.fix: Move Atom.infinite_of_relations to Basic.lean near the atom countability instance, and mk_eq_continuum to Topology.lean beside mk_le_continuum.
